question: Linda Noskova signs first major Tier-1 endorsement deal in marketability window
resolution_criterion: First major endorsement deal defined as: multi-million dollar partnership (single deal value >= $1M or annual value >= $500K) with a Tier-1 brand (Nike, Adidas, Under Armour, New Balance, Reebok, Puma, Gatorade, Pepsi, Coca-Cola, State Farm, or equivalent), confirmed by press announcement in Forbes, SportsBusiness Journal, Sportico, or equivalent Tier-1 sports business outlet.
